landed.selected: It is selected on the timeline.

pip.covers: This picture covers the one below.

insert.label: Insert at playhead
insert.hint: Put it at the playhead (snapping to the nearest cut) and push everything after it later.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.hint: Lay it over the timeline at the playhead, replacing whatever is under it. Nothing moves.

append.label: Add to end
append.hint: Put it after the last clip on the track.

placeOnTop.label: Place on top
placeOnTop.hint: Put it at the playhead on the topmost free track, or on a new track, without touching other clips.

placeOver.label: Place over
placeOver.hint: Put it at the playhead above the pictures already there, small in the bottom-right corner.

graphics.autoTrack: Choose a free track for me

plain.label: Plain (centred)
plain.hint: Large text in the middle of the picture.

lowerThird.label: Lower third
lowerThird.hint: Smaller text near the bottom, like a name caption.

boxed.label: Boxed
boxed.hint: Text on a solid box so it stays readable on any picture.

graphics.positionNote: This style keeps its own place on the picture. Pick Plain, Boxed or Outline to choose a position.
graphics.titleHint: It goes in at the playhead. The style decides where the text sits on the picture.

cut.inserted: {file} inserted at {time}{sound, select, yes { with its sound} other {}}{known, select, yes {} other { ({seconds, number} s - the source was not probed, trim to taste)}}.
cut.removed: Shot {id} removed; {frames, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} rippled out{linked, select, yes {, with the linked sound} other {}}.
cut.title: Cut
cut.overviewNote: The whole timeline at a glance. Click to move the playhead; the detail timeline below follows.
cut.poolFailed: The media pool could not be loaded.
cut.noSourcesHint: Upload some in the Media workspace.
cut.planNote: {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}}; long clips play faster ({min, number}× to {max, number}×).
cut.noAnalysis: This timeline was not made from an analysed run, so there is no measurement of which shots are long and still. Open the Analyse tab and analyse the footage, or run Watch footage on it and make a timeline from that run.
cut.noBoring: No long, still shot on this track.
cut.speechUnchecked: Speech was not checked: transcribe the footage in the Analyse tab so a cut never lands in the middle of a sentence.
cut.cutsQuiet: Cuts only the quiet {seconds} s; speech kept

stages.grade: Grade ({count, plural, one {# correction} other {# corrections}})

compose.title: Compose
compose.selectHint: Select a media clip (mask, keyer, corner pin, effects, stabilise, reframe), an insert (matte, corner keyframes) or an adjustment clip.
compose.addAdjustmentRange: Add adjustment clip over the marked range
compose.adjustmentNote: An adjustment clip grades and applies effects to everything below it for its span; it goes on a new top track.
compose.noKeyHere: No key at the playhead: editing moves the static value; add a key to animate from here.
compose.stabiliseTip: Two-pass vidstab at render time; the preview shows the unstabilised picture
compose.multiSelect: Several items are selected. Select one clip to see its properties.
compose.noSelectionProps: Nothing is selected. Pick a clip on the timeline.
compose.previewNote: Shown in the viewer as you edit. The finished video is exact.
compose.motionNote: Stabilising shows in the viewer once its steadied copy is ready. Smooth slow motion blends frames only in the finished video.

presets.none: No saved presets yet. Save the current settings as a preset to see it here.
presets.renameFailed: The preset could not be renamed.
presets.deletePrompt: Delete “{name}”? Clips that used it keep their settings.
presets.deleteFailed: The preset could not be deleted.
presets.duplicateFailed: The preset could not be duplicated.
presets.label: Preset
presets.saveTip: Save the current settings as a project preset

importResult.title: Import finished
importResult.offlineNote: Each offline clip is a gap of its own length with a red marker. Relink puts a file there, and you can undo it in one step.

relink.intro: Pick a file from this project. It goes where the red marker is, for as long as the gap, and you can undo it in one step.
relink.orAnother: Or another file from the media pool
